name: Protopasta Glass Fiber PCTG @base
filament_notes:
White Glass Fiber PCTG - stiff like PLA, durable like PCTG (~75% stiffer than unfilled PCTG).
Product page: 255C and up (they print up to 275C; 255C is a good compromise), 70-80C+ bed, about 2 mm3/s; reduce flow below 100% and add a nozzle wipe at layer change if material builds up on the nozzle.
This profile currently uses 250C, 80C plate and a 12 mm3/s cap - raise the nozzle toward 255C. Glass fiber is abrasive - use a hardened nozzle. Use Magigoo or glue stick.
